case_title: VINUBHAI RANCHHODBHAI PATEL v. RAJIVBHAI DUDABHAI PATEL & OTHERS
neutral_facts: The incident occurred in the village of Nana Ankadia on 11.07.1992, resulting in three deaths and five injuries. The police investigated, and a charge-sheet was filed against 15 accused. The Sessions Court convicted four accused for various offences, including murder and causing grievous hurt, while acquitting the remaining 13. The High Court dismissed the State's appeal against the acquittals. The case involved an alleged attack by all the accused, with the prosecution invoking Section 149 IPC for vicarious liability. The trial court did not clearly frame charges or record findings regarding the existence of an unlawful assembly or the common object of the assembly. The evidence included medical reports and witness statements, but the court did not adequately address the legal requirements for framing charges under the CrPC.
